correctness.rationale: Radial diagonalization and beta normalization follow directly from the orthonormal monomial basis. A lower-sector contour deformation is valid for all fixed alpha>-1. A single nondegenerate saddle yields the full explicit complex phase and prefactor with relative O_alpha(n^-1/2), and the contour bridge has geometric decay. Summing the resulting stretched-exponential eigenvalues gives Schatten membership for every p>0. The embedded checker executed 16 supporting comparisons but does not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The simplest bounded modulus-one reciprocal-boundary chirp provides a quantitative test of cancellation: spectral decay is stretched exponential despite the symbol not approaching zero anywhere. The exact complex phase and power weight dependence are mathematically meaningful spectral data, while all-Schatten membership strengthens the qualitative compactness question and polynomial sufficient bounds. This is not a routine consequence of radiality or classical beta integral evaluation.
